title: Towards Seconds-level Video Representation: Quadratically Gated Feature Grid with Adaptive, Prediction-free Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.17786v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Implicit neural video representations are notoriously slow to build, which does not cross the basic practical threshold for most industrial applications. Here, we present Q-GAS, a coordinate-queryable video representation that couples multi-resolution explicit 3D feature grids with a compact SwiGLU-style quadratic-gating (QG) decoder and an error-aware, prediction-free sampler. The explicit grids avoid hash-collision coefficient sharing at the cost of modestly higher storage yet greatly boost the expressive capacity; the QG decoder introduces low-rank local second-order interactions to improve the nonlinear feature response. During fitting, a global error map periodically refreshes a high-error pool, and each batch mixes pool samples with uniform samples, which is free from the auxiliary model to predict difficult samples, thereby further escalating the efficiency. On UVG Beauty/Bosphorus/Jockey, Q-GAS fits and quantizes under 50 s on

translated_title: 迈向秒级视频表示：具有自适应、免预测采样的二次门控特征网格
translated_abstract: 隐式神经视频表示的构建速度出了名地慢，未能达到大多数工业应用的基本实用门槛。在此，我们提出了Q-GAS，这是一种可坐标查询的视频表示，它将多分辨率显式3D特征网格与紧凑的SwiGLU风格二次门控（QG）解码器以及误差感知的免预测采样器相结合。显式网格以适度增加存储为代价，避免了哈希冲突导致的系数共享问题，从而大幅提升了表达能力；QG解码器引入低秩局部二阶交互来改善非线性特征响应。在拟合过程中，全局误差图定期刷新高误差池，每个训练批次将池样本与均匀采样样本混合，无需借助辅助模型来预测困难样本，从而进一步提升了效率。在UVG的Beauty/Bosphorus/Jockey序列上，Q-GAS在50秒内完成拟合与量化……
tldr: Q-GAS通过多分辨率显式3D特征网格、二次门控解码器和误差感知的免预测采样策略，实现了可在50秒内完成拟合的高效秒级隐式神经视频表示。
en_tdlr: Q-GAS achieves efficient seconds-level implicit neural video representation by coupling multi-resolution explicit 3D feature grids, a quadratic-gating decoder, and error-aware prediction-free sampling, fitting and quantizing UVG videos in under 50 seconds.
